mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the CPIAUCSL index (measuring inflation) is associated with lower real equity valuations due to increased discount rates and reduced real earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 20-day returns is greater than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer and business demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is greater than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (characterized by high GDP growth and low unemployment), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is greater than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS monthly change is below 50,000, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day returns is greater than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both INDPRO and GDPC1 declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is greater than -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is above its 90th percentile historical level, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of 20-day returns is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (characterized by rising FEDFUNDS), a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% per annum compresses equity valuations by increasing the risk-free rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime is greater than -0.03.
